page_description_chirho: Instructions your own agent can read to help you write a Perffection page. Review its answer before saving.
eyebrow_chirho: A guide for you and your agent
introduction_chirho: Use the AI you already work with to help write your page. Give it this public guide, then bring its answer back to Perffection. You keep the final say.
steps_heading_chirho: From an idea to your page
steps_chirho: Give your agent this page's address, or copy the instructions below. Add what you want people to know about your business and the contact details you want on the page.
Ask for its answer as JSON text. You do not need to write code or give the agent access to your Perffection account.
Sign in, open Use your own AI, and paste the answer. Review and correct the words in the editor, then choose Save. Publishing is a separate choice.
instructions_help_chirho: Copy this whole block, or let your agent read it here. These instructions come from the same contract used to check its answer.
privacy_note_chirho: Share only what your chosen agent needs. Never include your password, access keys or private customer records. This public guide contains no information from your account.
review_body_chirho: Use your own AI accepts the answer described here. Recover page content is different: it restores an exported Perffection page document, not an agent's answer.
signin_needed_chirho: Sign in first to review an answer in your workspace.
cost_note_chirho: This path does not call Perffection's AI or spend its AI credits. Your own agent or provider may charge you under its terms.
limits_body_chirho: The keys stay exactly as written, whatever language your page uses. Text limits are in characters. Review any warnings before saving.
copied_label_chirho: Copy the owner's value exactly, or leave empty
written_label_chirho: Plain text based on the owner's information
